spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m5p6t4 ----
(* Hospital OR scheduler: quorum voting on each admission, with a runtime  *)
(* capacity that gates the on-duty roster and starts a fresh vote epoch.  *)
(* Safety: a counted vote is always from an authorized, current-epoch     *)
(* participant.  Liveness: a standing quorum eventually resolves.         *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Participants, Cases, MaxCapacity, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, capacity, authorized, voteLog, ballot, admitted

vars == <<epoch, capacity, authorized, voteLog, ballot, admitted>>

QuorumReached ==
  /\ 2 * Cardinality(ballot) > Cardinality(authorized)
  /\ \A p \in ballot : voteLog[p] = epoch
  /\ Cases \ admitted # {}

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ capacity = MaxCapacity
  /\ authorized = {}
  /\ voteLog = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
  /\ ballot = {}
  /\ admitted = {}

ChangeCapacity(newCap) ==
  /\ ~QuorumReached
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ capacity' = newCap
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ ballot' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, voteLog, admitted>>

Authorize(p) ==
  /\ p \notin authorized
  /\ ~QuorumReached
  /\ Cardinality(authorized) < capacity
  /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, voteLog, ballot, admitted>>

Deauthorize(p) ==
  /\ p \in authorized
  /\ ~QuorumReached
  /\ authorized' = authorized \ {p}
  /\ ballot' = ballot \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, voteLog, admitted>>

CastVote(p) ==
  /\ p \in authorized
  /\ ballot' = ballot \cup {p}
  /\ voteLog' = [voteLog EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, authorized, admitted>>

AdmitCase ==
  /\ QuorumReached
  /\ admitted' = admitted \cup {CHOOSE c \in Cases \ admitted : TRUE}
  /\ ballot' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, authorized, voteLog>>

Next ==
  \/ \E newCap \in 1..MaxCapacity : ChangeCapacity(newCap)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Authorize(p)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Deauthorize(p)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : CastVote(p)
  \/ AdmitCase

AdmitStep == AdmitCase

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(AdmitStep)

\* Safety: every ballot member is currently authorized and voted this epoch.
BallotIntegrity == \A p \in ballot : p \in authorized /\ voteLog[p] = epoch

\* Liveness: a standing quorum is always eventually resolved into an admission.
LivenessProp == QuorumReached ~> ballot = {}

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Participants = {p1, p2, p3}
  Cases = {c1, c2}
  MaxCapacity = 3
  MaxEpoch = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT BallotIntegrity
PROPERTY LivenessProp
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler admits surgical cases into the day's OR
block only after a quorum vote among the currently on-duty charge staff. The
on-duty roster is capped by how many operating rooms are open that shift, and
that capacity changes at runtime as rooms open or close for cleaning,
staffing shortages, or emergencies; each capacity change starts a fresh
voting epoch and invalidates (stales) any vote cast before it. Staff cast
votes toward admitting the next case, but a vote only counts if the voter is
currently on the authorized roster and cast that vote during the current
epoch -- anyone dropped from the roster, or whose vote predates the latest
capacity change, is stale or unauthorized and must not influence the outcome.
Once a strict majority of the authorized roster has cast fresh votes for the
pending case, the scheduler admits a case and clears the ballot for the next
round. Roster changes and capacity changes are held off while a quorum is
already standing, so an in-flight quorum cannot be disrupted before it is
resolved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at every reachable state, every vote counted on the current
ballot was cast by a participant who is presently on the authorized roster
and whose vote was recorded during the current voting epoch.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: whenever the on-duty roster reaches a fresh-vote quorum
for a pending case, the scheduler eventually admits a case and clears the
ballot.

---- MODULE W4Od0m8p0t4 ----
(* Hospital OR scheduler with hierarchical (coarse zone, then fine table)
   locking. Different zones can be worked concurrently; within a zone the
   coarse lock serializes bookkeeping, and the fine lock is the actual
   exclusive claim on a table. Runtime capacity changes which table indices
   are open to *new* claims, without disturbing tables already in use. The
   invariant checks the literal mutual-exclusion property over an explicit
   holder relation, not a function, so a guard bug would be observable. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Staff, MaxTables, NumZones, NoOne
ASSUME /\ MaxTables \in Nat /\ MaxTables >= 2
       /\ NumZones \in Nat /\ NumZones >= 1 /\ NumZones <= MaxTables
       /\ Staff # {}
       /\ NoOne \notin Staff

Tables == 1..MaxTables
Zones == 1..NumZones
Zone(t) == ((t - 1) % NumZones) + 1

VARIABLES capacity, coarseHolder, holders, lastCapacityChanger

vars == <<capacity, coarseHolder, holders, lastCapacityChanger>>

TypeOK == /\ capacity \in 1..MaxTables
          /\ coarseHolder \in [Zones -> Staff \cup {NoOne}]
          /\ holders \subseteq (Staff \X Tables)
          /\ lastCapacityChanger \in Staff \cup {NoOne}

Init == /\ capacity = MaxTables
        /\ coarseHolder = [z \in Zones |-> NoOne]
        /\ holders = {}
        /\ lastCapacityChanger = NoOne

AcquireCoarse == \E s \in Staff, z \in Zones :
                    /\ coarseHolder[z] = NoOne
                    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![z] = s]
                    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, holders, lastCapacityChanger>>

\* Claiming a table requires already holding its zone's coarse lock.
AcquireFine == \E s \in Staff, t \in Tables :
                    /\ t <= capacity
                    /\ coarseHolder[Zone(t)] = s
                    /\ ~\E s2 \in Staff : <<s2, t>> \in holders
                    /\ holders' = holders \cup {<<s, t>>}
                    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, coarseHolder, lastCapacityChanger>>

ReleaseFine == \E s \in Staff, t \in Tables :
                    /\ <<s, t>> \in holders
                    /\ holders' = holders \ {<<s, t>>}
                    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, coarseHolder, lastCapacityChanger>>

\* Coarse lock releases only after that staff member's tables in the zone are clear.
ReleaseCoarse == \E s \in Staff, z \in Zones :
                    /\ coarseHolder[z] = s
                    /\ ~\E t \in Tables : Zone(t) = z /\ <<s, t>> \in holders
                    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![z] = NoOne]
                    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, holders, lastCapacityChanger>>

\* Runtime capacity change: tables above the new count are closed to new claims;
\* the charge nurse who made the change is recorded for the audit trail.
ChangeCapacity == \E s \in Staff, c \in 1..MaxTables :
                    /\ capacity' = c
                    /\ lastCapacityChanger' = s
                    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, holders>>

Next == AcquireCoarse \/ AcquireFine \/ ReleaseFine \/ ReleaseCoarse \/ ChangeCapacity

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Literal property: at most one staff member ever holds a given table.
TableMutualExclusion == \A t \in Tables : Cardinality({s \in Staff : <<s, t>> \in holders}) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Staff = {s1, s2, s3}
    MaxTables = 3
    NumZones = 2
    NoOne = none
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT TableMutualExclusion
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler protects each operating table with a pair of
hierarchical locks. Tables are grouped into wing zones; before a staff member may
claim a specific table they must first hold the coarse lock for that table's
zone, and only then may they claim the table's own fine-grained lock. Several
zones can be worked independently at once, so different staff members can be
operating in different zones concurrently, but the coarse lock keeps two staff
members from racing over the same zone's bookkeeping and the fine lock keeps two
staff members from ever being assigned the same table at the same time. The
number of tables actually in service can change at runtime -- a table can be
taken out of the rotation for cleaning or brought back in -- and an in-service
count that shrinks below a table's index leaves any table already in use
grandfathered until it is released, while blocking new assignments beyond the
new count. SAFETY PROPERTY: no operating table is ever held by two different
staff members at the same time, regardless of how the in-service table count
changes at runtime.

---- MODULE W4Od10m1p6t0 ----
(* Subway block-signalling token ring. A token circulates in ring order and
   carries a generation number; only the current, non-stale holder may admit
   a train. A single controller may crash silently, and the ring must be
   able to route around it. The ledger records the authoritative holder of
   every generation, so admissions can be checked for staleness. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, MaxGen
ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 3 /\ MaxGen \in Nat /\ MaxGen >= 2

Participants == 1..N
NextInRing(p) == IF p = N THEN 1 ELSE p + 1
MaxRec == MaxGen + 1

VARIABLES pos, gen, crashed, ledger, admittedBy

vars == <<pos, gen, crashed, ledger, admittedBy>>

TypeOK == /\ pos \in Participants
          /\ gen \in 0..MaxRec
          /\ crashed \subseteq Participants /\ Cardinality(crashed) <= 1
          /\ ledger \in [0..MaxRec -> Participants \cup {0}]
          /\ admittedBy \in [0..MaxRec -> Participants \cup {0}]

Init == /\ pos = 1
        /\ gen = 0
        /\ crashed = {}
        /\ ledger = [g \in 0..MaxRec |-> IF g = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0]
        /\ admittedBy = [g \in 0..MaxRec |-> 0]

\* The live holder admits a train, stamping the ledger's current generation.
Admit == /\ pos \notin crashed
         /\ admittedBy' = [admittedBy EXCEPT ![gen] = pos]
         /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, gen, crashed, ledger>>

\* The live holder hands the token onward, advancing the generation.
PassToken == /\ pos \notin crashed
             /\ gen < MaxGen
             /\ pos' = NextInRing(pos)
             /\ gen' = gen + 1
             /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![gen + 1] = NextInRing(pos)]
             /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, admittedBy>>

\* Recovery: a crashed holder is always routed around, even past the normal
\* generation bound, so a crash can never leave the ring stuck.
SkipCrashedHolder == /\ pos \in crashed
                     /\ pos' = NextInRing(pos)
                     /\ gen' = gen + 1
                     /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![gen + 1] = NextInRing(pos)]
                     /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, admittedBy>>

\* At most one controller ever crashes silently.
Crash == /\ crashed = {}
         /\ \E p \in Participants : crashed' = {p}
         /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, gen, ledger, admittedBy>>

Next == Admit \/ PassToken \/ SkipCrashedHolder \/ Crash

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(PassToken) /\ WF_vars(SkipCrashedHolder)

\* Safety: any recorded admission at generation g matches the ledger's holder for g.
ValidAdmissions == \A g \in 0..MaxGen : admittedBy[g] # 0 => admittedBy[g] = ledger[g]

\* Liveness: despite the single silent crash, the ring keeps advancing to its bound.
RingKeepsAdvancing == <>(gen = MaxGen)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxGen = 4
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT ValidAdmissions
PROPERTY RingKeepsAdvancing
nl:
A subway signalling block system uses a token ring to grant exclusive admission
authority over a line of track blocks. A single physical token circulates among
the block controllers in ring order; whichever controller currently holds the
token is the only one authorized to admit a train into its block, and the token
carries a generation number that increases every time it changes hands, so a
controller can tell whether the copy of the token it is looking at is current or
stale. At most one block controller can crash silently at any point, going dark
without warning; the ring must notice the dark controller and reissue the token
onward so that circulation continues, and no controller may ever admit a train on
the strength of a generation number that does not match the ring's authoritative
record of who legitimately held the token at that generation. SAFETY PROPERTY:
every recorded train admission is stamped with a token generation that matches
the ring's own ledger of which controller legitimately held that generation,
so no unauthorized or stale controller ever admits a train. LIVENESS PROPERTY:
even though one block controller may crash silently, the token's generation
counter always eventually reaches its configured bound, meaning the ring keeps
advancing and never stalls permanently on the dark controller.

---- MODULE W4Od12m8p6t3 ----
(* Blood-bank inventory tracker with hierarchical locking: a coarse category
   lock gates access to per-unit fine locks. The category lock is stamped
   with a generation, and an authoritative ledger records who legitimately
   held each generation, so a stale category authorization can be detected.
   No technician ever fails, only slows down; one designated slow technician
   must never be starved out of the category lock. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Participants, Units, MaxGen, SlowP, NoOne
ASSUME /\ MaxGen \in Nat /\ MaxGen >= 3
       /\ SlowP \in Participants
       /\ Units # {}
       /\ NoOne \notin Participants

VARIABLES coarseHolder, gen, ledger, fineHolder, accessedAt

vars == <<coarseHolder, gen, ledger, fineHolder, accessedAt>>

TypeOK == /\ coarseHolder \in Participants \cup {NoOne}
          /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
          /\ ledger \in [0..MaxGen -> Participants \cup {NoOne}]
          /\ fineHolder \in [Units -> Participants \cup {NoOne}]
          /\ accessedAt \in [Units -> 0..MaxGen]

Init == /\ coarseHolder = NoOne
        /\ gen = 0
        /\ ledger = [g \in 0..MaxGen |-> NoOne]
        /\ fineHolder = [u \in Units |-> NoOne]
        /\ accessedAt = [u \in Units |-> 0]

\* The designated slow technician takes the free category lock. The ledger
\* only grows while gen is below its tracked bound; once it saturates the
\* lock keeps cycling (for liveness) but the ledger simply stops extending.
AcquireCoarseSlow == /\ coarseHolder = NoOne
                     /\ coarseHolder' = SlowP
                     /\ gen' = IF gen < MaxGen THEN gen + 1 ELSE gen
                     /\ ledger' = IF gen < MaxGen THEN [ledger EXCEPT ![gen + 1] = SlowP] ELSE ledger
                     /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, accessedAt>>

\* Any other technician takes the free category lock, same saturating rule.
AcquireCoarseOther == \E p \in Participants \ {SlowP} :
                     /\ coarseHolder = NoOne
                     /\ coarseHolder' = p
                     /\ gen' = IF gen < MaxGen THEN gen + 1 ELSE gen
                     /\ ledger' = IF gen < MaxGen THEN [ledger EXCEPT ![gen + 1] = p] ELSE ledger
                     /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, accessedAt>>

ReleaseCoarse == /\ coarseHolder # NoOne
                 /\ coarseHolder' = NoOne
                 /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, ledger, fineHolder, accessedAt>>

\* Touching a unit requires currently, live-holding the category lock, and
\* only while the ledger window is still tracking generations.
AcquireFine == \E p \in Participants, u \in Units :
                 /\ coarseHolder = p
                 /\ gen < MaxGen
                 /\ fineHolder[u] = NoOne
                 /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![u] = p]
                 /\ accessedAt' = [accessedAt EXCEPT ![u] = gen]
                 /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, gen, ledger>>

ReleaseFine == \E p \in Participants, u \in Units :
                 /\ fineHolder[u] = p
                 /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![u] = NoOne]
                 /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, gen, ledger, accessedAt>>

Next == AcquireCoarseSlow \/ AcquireCoarseOther \/ ReleaseCoarse \/ AcquireFine \/ ReleaseFine

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(ReleaseCoarse) /\ SF_vars(AcquireCoarseSlow)

\* Safety: any recorded unit access matches the ledger's holder for its stamped generation.
AuthorizedAccess == \A u \in Units : fineHolder[u] # NoOne => fineHolder[u] = ledger[accessedAt[u]]

\* Liveness: the slow technician is never starved out of the category lock.
SlowEventuallyServed == <>(coarseHolder = SlowP)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {slowp, o1}
    Units = {u1, u2}
    MaxGen = 4
    SlowP = slowp
    NoOne = none
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AuthorizedAccess
PROPERTY SlowEventuallyServed
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards its shelves with hierarchical locks: a
technician must first hold the coarse lock on a blood-type category before
touching the fine lock on any individual unit within that category. The coarse
lock is exclusive and stamped with a generation number that increases every time
it changes hands, and the ring of technicians keeps an authoritative ledger of
which technician legitimately held the category lock at each generation. A
technician may be slow -- it can take its time between acquiring the category
lock and acquiring or releasing a unit lock -- but no technician ever fails or
disappears. What must never happen is a technician drawing or returning a unit
based on a category authorization that has gone stale, i.e. that no longer
matches the ledger's record of who legitimately held the category at that
generation. SAFETY PROPERTY: every recorded access to a blood unit is stamped
with a category-lock generation that matches the ledger's own record of which
technician legitimately held that generation, so no unauthorized or stale
technician ever touches a unit. LIVENESS PROPERTY: even when other technicians
are repeatedly cycling through the category lock, one designated slow technician
is never starved -- it always eventually obtains the category lock itself.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS A, B, TotalUnits, MaxEpoch

Instances == {A, B}

VARIABLES epoch, owner, pool, issued, localEpoch

vars == <<epoch, owner, pool, issued, localEpoch>>

\* MaxEpoch bounds how many reconfigurations can happen, which keeps the
\* epoch counter (and every instance's synced copy of it) finite for TLC.
EpochRange == 0 .. MaxEpoch

\* Epoch-numbered reconfiguration: only the instance that owns the current
\* epoch, and has synced its local record up to that epoch, may dispense a
\* unit from the one shared pool the two instances both operate against.

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ owner = A
    /\ pool = TotalUnits
    /\ issued = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ localEpoch = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

\* Hand authority to the other instance and advance the epoch, bounded so
\* the reachable state space stays finite.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ owner' = (IF owner = A THEN B ELSE A)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, issued, localEpoch>>

\* An instance catches its local record up to the current epoch.
Sync(i) ==
    /\ localEpoch[i] # epoch
    /\ localEpoch' = [localEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, pool, issued>>

\* Only the current, synced epoch owner may dispense a unit.
Issue(i) ==
    /\ owner = i
    /\ localEpoch[i] = epoch
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, localEpoch>>

\* Either instance may restock a unit it had previously dispensed.
Restock(i) ==
    /\ issued[i] > 0
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![i] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, localEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Sync(i) \/ Issue(i) \/ Restock(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: units are only ever moved between the pool and an
\* instance's dispensed count; the total never changes.
UnitsConserved == pool + issued[A] + issued[B] = TotalUnits
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  A = A
  B = B
  TotalUnits = 4
  MaxEpoch = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT UnitsConserved
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker runs as two independent software instances,
A and B, that both read and write against one shared physical unit pool
for a given blood type. Rather than locking the pool directly, the tracker
uses epoch-numbered reconfiguration: a monotonically increasing epoch
number designates which single instance is currently authoritative to
dispense units, and each instance keeps a local record of the last epoch
it has synchronized with. Only the authoritative instance for the current
epoch, and only after it has synced its local record up to that epoch, may
dispense a unit out of the shared pool; either instance may return a
previously dispensed unit back into the pool (for example, an expired unit
being restocked). A reconfiguration event advances the epoch and hands
authority to the other instance, so a stale instance that has not synced
cannot keep dispensing under an epoch it no longer owns. Across every
reconfiguration and every dispense or return, the units are only ever
moved between the shared pool and an instance's dispensed count, never
created or destroyed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the units in the shared pool
plus the units dispensed and not yet returned by instance A plus the units
dispensed and not yet returned by instance B equal the blood type's fixed
total unit count.

---- MODULE W4Od14m3p4t0 ----
(* Wildfire drone swarm with term-based leader election and failover. Only
   the current leader may dispatch a drone into the fire perimeter, and the
   perimeter's simultaneous occupancy is bounded. At most one drone (leader
   or otherwise) can crash silently; failover elects a fresh leader by term,
   and a sweep clears a crashed drone's airspace slot once noticed. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, MaxActive, MaxTerm, NoOne
ASSUME /\ MaxActive \in Nat /\ MaxActive >= 1
       /\ MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 2
       /\ Cardinality(Drones) > MaxActive
       /\ NoOne \notin Drones

VARIABLES leader, term, crashed, active

vars == <<leader, term, crashed, active>>

TypeOK == /\ leader \in Drones \cup {NoOne}
          /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
          /\ crashed \subseteq Drones /\ Cardinality(crashed) <= 1
          /\ active \subseteq Drones

Init == /\ leader = NoOne
        /\ term = 0
        /\ crashed = {}
        /\ active = {}

\* Election happens when there is no leader, or the leader has crashed.
Elect == /\ term < MaxTerm
         /\ leader = NoOne \/ leader \in crashed
         /\ \E d \in Drones \ crashed :
               /\ leader' = d
               /\ term' = term + 1
         /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, active>>

\* Only a live, current leader may dispatch a drone, under the capacity bound.
Dispatch == /\ leader # NoOne /\ leader \notin crashed
            /\ \E d \in Drones \ active :
                  /\ Cardinality(active) < MaxActive
                  /\ active' = active \cup {d}
            /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

Recall == \E d \in active : active' = active \ {d} /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

\* At most one drone crashes silently, at any time.
Crash == /\ crashed = {}
         /\ \E d \in Drones : crashed' = {d}
         /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, active>>

\* Failover sweep: a noticed crashed drone is dropped from the active roster.
ClearCrashed == \E d \in crashed \cap active : active' = active \ {d} /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, crashed>>

Next == Elect \/ Dispatch \/ Recall \/ Crash \/ ClearCrashed

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Literal property: airspace occupancy never exceeds the configured bound.
CapacityBound == Cardinality(active) <= MaxActive
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2, d3}
    MaxActive = 2
    MaxTerm = 4
    NoOne = none
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CapacityBound
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm elects a leader by term to coordinate which
drones are dispatched over an active fire perimeter. The elected leader is the
only drone authorized to dispatch a teammate into the perimeter's airspace, and
elections increment a term counter so old leadership claims cannot linger. At
most one drone in the swarm can crash silently at any time, including the
leader itself; when that happens the swarm holds a failover election among the
surviving drones to install a new leader, and the roster of dispatched drones is
swept to drop the crashed drone once it is noticed, freeing its airspace slot.
The perimeter's airspace can only safely hold a fixed number of drones at once
no matter how leadership changes hands or how the crash and failover play out.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of drones simultaneously dispatched into the fire
perimeter's airspace never exceeds the configured bounded capacity, even across
elections, failovers, and the single silent crash.

---- MODULE W4Od14m5p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, Quorum

VARIABLES votes, crashed, commitCount, committedBy

Vars == <<votes, crashed, commitCount, committedBy>>

YesVoters == {d \in Drones : votes[d] = "yes"}
QuorumReached == Cardinality(YesVoters) >= Quorum

TypeOK ==
  /\ votes \in [Drones -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Drones
  /\ commitCount \in 0..1
  /\ committedBy \in Drones \cup {"none"}

Init ==
  /\ votes = [d \in Drones |-> "none"]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ commitCount = 0
  /\ committedBy = "none"

VoteYes(d) ==
  /\ votes[d] = "none"
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![d] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, commitCount, committedBy>>

VoteNo(d) ==
  /\ votes[d] = "none"
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![d] = "no"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, commitCount, committedBy>>

\* At most one drone ever crashes, and only before it has cast a vote --
\* the swarm's quorum must never depend on that drone's vote arriving.
Crash(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) = 0
  /\ votes[d] = "none"
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, commitCount, committedBy>>

\* The irreversible release fires at most once, gated on quorum, and the
\* triggering drone must itself have voted yes.
Commit(d) ==
  /\ commitCount = 0
  /\ votes[d] = "yes"
  /\ QuorumReached
  /\ commitCount' = 1
  /\ committedBy' = d
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

\* If enough drones voted no that quorum can never be reached, the swarm
\* simply idles rather than deadlocking -- that is a legitimate outcome.
Idle == UNCHANGED Vars

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : VoteYes(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : VoteNo(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Commit(d)
  \/ Idle

AnyCommit == \E d \in Drones : Commit(d)

\* Weak fairness on the release itself is enough: quorum, once reached,
\* never goes away (votes are never retracted), so this alone forces progress.
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_Vars /\ WF_Vars(AnyCommit)

\* The literal property for this cell is at-most-once execution, so the
\* single-guard shape here is the property itself, not a stand-in for it.
AtMostOnce ==
  /\ commitCount <= 1
  /\ commitCount = 1 => (votes[committedBy] = "yes" /\ QuorumReached)

\* Quorum, once reached, is never permanently stalled by the crashed drone.
EventualRelease == QuorumReached ~> (commitCount = 1)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
Drones = {d1, d2, d3}
Quorum = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AtMostOnce
PROPERTY EventualRelease
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm of drones monitors a fire perimeter and can
trigger one irreversible action: releasing a fire-retardant payload onto the
confirmed hotspot. Before the payload is released, each drone casts a single
yes-or-no vote on whether the hotspot is confirmed; the swarm only proceeds
once a quorum of drones has voted yes. Any one drone in the swarm can crash
silently at any time before it votes -- it simply stops responding forever,
and the swarm must not need that drone's vote to reach quorum or to trigger
the payload release. Because releasing the payload cannot be undone, the
swarm must never trigger it more than once no matter how the remaining
drones' votes arrive. Once enough surviving drones have voted yes to reach
quorum, the swarm must still be able to actually carry out the release rather
than stall forever waiting on the silently crashed drone.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the payload release happens at
most once, and if it has happened the triggering drone's own vote was yes and
a quorum of yes votes was present.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever a quorum of drones has voted yes, the swarm
eventually carries out the payload release.

---- MODULE W4Od16m0p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Alpha, Beta, Slots

Instances == {Alpha, Beta}

VARIABLES attemptSlot, validRead, claimed, retryCount

vars == <<attemptSlot, validRead, claimed, retryCount>>

\* Optimistic locking with retry: an instance reads a slot with no lock
\* taken and remembers it as valid; any commit or release that touches
\* that slot invalidates every other instance's outstanding read of it,
\* forcing them to retry instead of blindly reclaiming a stale view.

FreeSlot(s) == \A i \in Instances : s \notin claimed[i]

Init ==
    /\ attemptSlot = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
    /\ validRead = [i \in Instances |-> FALSE]
    /\ claimed = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ retryCount = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

Read(i, s) ==
    /\ attemptSlot[i] = "none"
    /\ FreeSlot(s)
    /\ attemptSlot' = [attemptSlot EXCEPT ![i] = s]
    /\ validRead' = [validRead EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, retryCount>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ attemptSlot[i] # "none"
    /\ validRead[i]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {attemptSlot[i]}]
    /\ validRead' = [j \in Instances |->
                        IF j # i /\ attemptSlot[j] = attemptSlot[i]
                        THEN FALSE ELSE validRead[j]]
    /\ attemptSlot' = [attemptSlot EXCEPT ![i] = "none"]
    /\ retryCount' = [retryCount EXCEPT ![i] = 0]

Retry(i) ==
    /\ attemptSlot[i] # "none"
    /\ ~validRead[i]
    /\ attemptSlot' = [attemptSlot EXCEPT ![i] = "none"]
    /\ retryCount' = [retryCount EXCEPT ![i] = IF @ < 2 THEN @ + 1 ELSE 2]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, validRead>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ \E s \in claimed[i] :
        /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![i] = @ \ {s}]
        /\ validRead' = [j \in Instances |->
                            IF attemptSlot[j] = s THEN FALSE ELSE validRead[j]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attemptSlot, retryCount>>

CommitAlpha == Commit(Alpha)
CommitBeta == Commit(Beta)
RetryAlpha == Retry(Alpha)
RetryBeta == Retry(Beta)
ReleaseAlpha == Release(Alpha)
ReleaseBeta == Release(Beta)

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Read(Alpha, s) \/ Read(Beta, s)
    \/ CommitAlpha \/ CommitBeta
    \/ RetryAlpha \/ RetryBeta
    \/ ReleaseAlpha \/ ReleaseBeta

\* Every pending attempt is guaranteed to be resolved, either into a
\* commit or a conflict-triggered retry.
Fairness ==
    /\ WF_vars(CommitAlpha) /\ WF_vars(CommitBeta)
    /\ WF_vars(RetryAlpha) /\ WF_vars(RetryBeta)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

\* No slot is ever claimed by two distinct instances at once.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A s \in Slots : \A i, j \in Instances :
        (s \in claimed[i] /\ s \in claimed[j]) => i = j

AttemptsResolve ==
    /\ (attemptSlot[Alpha] # "none") ~> (attemptSlot[Alpha] = "none")
    /\ (attemptSlot[Beta] # "none") ~> (attemptSlot[Beta] = "none")
====

CONSTANTS
  Alpha = Alpha
  Beta = Beta
  Slots = {s1, s2}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
PROPERTY AttemptsResolve
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs two independent dispenser instances,
Alpha and Beta, that both draw from one shared pool of dispensing slots.
Each slot carries a version counter. To claim a slot for a prescription, an
instance first reads the slot's current version optimistically -- without
taking any lock -- and records that version as its own snapshot. When the
instance is ready to commit, it may only claim the slot if the slot is
still free and its recorded snapshot still matches the slot's live version;
a successful commit bumps the version and records the instance's own belief
that it now holds the slot. If another instance's commit or release changed
the version in the meantime, the optimistic commit is rejected as a
conflict and the instance must retry with a fresh read. A slot's holder may
also release it back to the free pool, which likewise bumps the version so
that any stale in-flight attempt on that slot is forced to retry rather
than silently succeed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, for any two instances, if both
believe they currently hold a claim on the same slot then the two
instances are the same instance -- no slot is ever double-allocated.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever an instance begins an optimistic attempt on a
slot, that attempt eventually resolves, either by successfully committing
the claim or by detecting the version conflict and aborting to retry.

---- MODULE W4Od16m6p2t4 ----
(* Pharmacy dispenser: a single lease slot with expiry moves pills between  *)
(* free stock, an outstanding lease, and a dispensed total.  Capacity      *)
(* changes at runtime (restock / write-off) are the only source or sink,   *)
(* so the three buckets always sum back to the current capacity.          *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Stations, NoStation, MaxCapacity, LeaseTTL, MaxDispensed

VARIABLES capacity, stock, holder, heldAmt, age, dispensedTotal

vars == <<capacity, stock, holder, heldAmt, age, dispensedTotal>>

Init ==
  /\ capacity = 0
  /\ stock = 0
  /\ holder = NoStation
  /\ heldAmt = 0
  /\ age = 0
  /\ dispensedTotal = 0

Restock(amt) ==
  /\ amt > 0 /\ capacity + amt <= MaxCapacity
  /\ capacity' = capacity + amt
  /\ stock' = stock + amt
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, heldAmt, age, dispensedTotal>>

Writedown(amt) ==
  /\ amt > 0 /\ amt <= stock
  /\ capacity' = capacity - amt
  /\ stock' = stock - amt
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, heldAmt, age, dispensedTotal>>

GrantLease(station, amt) ==
  /\ holder = NoStation
  /\ amt \in 1..stock
  /\ holder' = station
  /\ heldAmt' = amt
  /\ stock' = stock - amt
  /\ age' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, dispensedTotal>>

Tick ==
  /\ holder # NoStation
  /\ age < LeaseTTL
  /\ age' = age + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, stock, holder, heldAmt, dispensedTotal>>

Dispense ==
  /\ holder # NoStation
  /\ age < LeaseTTL
  /\ dispensedTotal' = dispensedTotal + heldAmt
  /\ dispensedTotal + heldAmt <= MaxDispensed
  /\ holder' = NoStation
  /\ heldAmt' = 0
  /\ age' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, stock>>

Reclaim ==
  /\ holder # NoStation
  /\ age >= LeaseTTL
  /\ stock' = stock + heldAmt
  /\ holder' = NoStation
  /\ heldAmt' = 0
  /\ age' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, dispensedTotal>>

ResolveStep == Dispense \/ Reclaim

\* Capacity is maxed out with nothing free and nothing outstanding: the
\* pipeline has drained, so idle here instead of reporting a deadlock.
Done == /\ holder = NoStation
        /\ stock = 0
        /\ capacity = MaxCapacity

Terminating == Done /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E amt \in 1..MaxCapacity : Restock(amt)
  \/ \E amt \in 1..MaxCapacity : Writedown(amt)
  \/ \E station \in Stations, amt \in 1..MaxCapacity : GrantLease(station, amt)
  \/ Tick
  \/ ResolveStep
  \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(ResolveStep)

\* Safety: the three pill buckets always sum to the current capacity.
Conservation == stock + heldAmt + dispensedTotal = capacity

\* Liveness: an outstanding lease is always eventually resolved.
LivenessProp == (holder # NoStation) ~> (holder = NoStation)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {pharm1, pharm2}
  NoStation = NoStation
  MaxCapacity = 3
  LeaseTTL = 1
  MaxDispensed = 4

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
PROPERTY LivenessProp
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser tracks a single running count of pills
that must never be created or destroyed except through an explicit stock
adjustment. The system's provisioned capacity changes at runtime as new
stock is received or expired stock is written off, and each adjustment
moves the same amount into (or out of) both the capacity ceiling and the
free-stock count together, so nothing is gained or lost in the move. To
fill a prescription, one station takes out a lease on a batch of pills
pulled from free stock; the lease has a bounded lifetime measured in
ticks. If the lease is used before it expires, the held pills are recorded
as dispensed to a patient; if it expires unrenewed, the held pills are
reclaimed back into free stock instead of vanishing. Only one lease can be
outstanding at a time, so every pill in the system is at every moment
accounted for as exactly one of: free stock, held under the current
lease, or already dispensed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at every reachable state, free stock plus the amount held
under the current lease plus the running dispensed total equals the
current capacity -- the pill count is fully conserved across restocks,
write-offs, leases, dispenses, and expirations.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: whenever a station is holding an outstanding lease, the
system eventually resolves it -- either by dispensing the held pills to a
patient or by reclaiming them back into free stock after expiry -- so no
lease is held forever.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m7p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, Orders, Instances

VARIABLES reg, activeGrant, pending, pendingOrder

Vars == <<reg, activeGrant, pending, pendingOrder>>

Empty == "empty"
NoSlot == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Slots -> Orders \cup {Empty}]
  /\ activeGrant \subseteq (Slots \times Orders)
  /\ pending \in [Instances -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]
  /\ pendingOrder \in [Instances -> Orders]

Init ==
  /\ reg = [s \in Slots |-> Empty]
  /\ activeGrant = {}
  /\ pending = [i \in Instances |-> NoSlot]
  /\ pendingOrder = [i \in Instances |-> CHOOSE o \in Orders : TRUE]

\* An instance reads the pool and decides which slot/order it wants next.
StartClaim(i, s, o) ==
  /\ pending[i] = NoSlot
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = s]
  /\ pendingOrder' = [pendingOrder EXCEPT ![i] = o]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, activeGrant>>

\* The compare-and-swap re-checks the LIVE register, not a stale read, so a
\* rival instance that already claimed the slot always loses the race here.
CompleteClaim(i) ==
  /\ pending[i] # NoSlot
  /\ reg[pending[i]] = Empty
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![pending[i]] = pendingOrder[i]]
  /\ activeGrant' = activeGrant \cup {<<pending[i], pendingOrder[i]>>}
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NoSlot]
  /\ UNCHANGED pendingOrder

\* A stale compare-and-swap fails and the instance gives up this attempt.
AbortClaim(i) ==
  /\ pending[i] # NoSlot
  /\ reg[pending[i]] # Empty
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = NoSlot]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, activeGrant, pendingOrder>>

\* A slot is freed once its prescription has been picked up.
PickUp(s) ==
  /\ reg[s] # Empty
  /\ activeGrant' = activeGrant \ {<<s, reg[s]>>}
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = Empty]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, pendingOrder>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Slots, o \in Orders : StartClaim(i, s, o)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : CompleteClaim(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : AbortClaim(i)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : PickUp(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_Vars

\* No slot ever carries two different active grants, and the log of grants
\* always agrees with the live register -- disclosed: this cell's literal
\* property family is slot-allocation uniqueness, so the pairwise shape here
\* is the property itself, not a discouraged substitute for it.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  /\ \A s \in Slots : \A o1, o2 \in Orders :
       (<<s, o1>> \in activeGrant /\ <<s, o2>> \in activeGrant) => o1 = o2
  /\ \A s \in Slots : \A o \in Orders : <<s, o>> \in activeGrant => reg[s] = o
====
nl:
A pharmacy runs two independent dispenser instances -- a front-counter
terminal and a drive-through terminal -- that share one physical pool of
prescription pickup slots. To assign a slot to a filled prescription, a
dispenser instance reads the slot's current owner register and then performs
a compare-and-swap: the swap only succeeds if the register still holds the
expected "empty" value at the moment of the swap, and it atomically installs
the prescription's order id as the new owner. Because both instances poll and
swap against the same shared registers without coordinating with each other
beyond the compare-and-swap itself, a slot's register can be claimed by
whichever instance's compare-and-swap lands first; the other instance's stale
compare-and-swap must then fail rather than overwrite the winner. A slot is
freed back to "empty" only once its prescription has been picked up. The pool
must never let a slot end up allocated to two different prescription order
ids at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, every pickup slot's owner register
holds at most one prescription order id -- no slot is ever double-allocated
by the two competing dispenser instances.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m3p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, Doors, MaxTerm

VARIABLES term, leader, localTerm, lockState, lastActor, authTerm

vars == <<term, leader, localTerm, lockState, lastActor, authTerm>>

\* Leader election with failover: only the elected leader, once it has
\* synced its local term to the current one, may command a door. A manual
\* physical override needs no network authorization at all, and is
\* recorded as having no controller origin so it can never be confused
\* with an authorized network command.

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ localTerm = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ lockState = [d \in Doors |-> "locked"]
    /\ lastActor = [d \in Doors |-> "none"]
    /\ authTerm = [d \in Doors |-> 0]

\* A failover elects a new leader and advances the term, bounded so the
\* term counter (and the state space) stays finite for TLC.
Elect ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ \E c \in Controllers :
        /\ leader' = c
        /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<localTerm, lockState, lastActor, authTerm>>

\* A controller learns about the current term.
Sync(c) ==
    /\ localTerm[c] # term
    /\ localTerm' = [localTerm EXCEPT ![c] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, lockState, lastActor, authTerm>>

\* Only the synced current leader may command a door.
Actuate(c, d) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ localTerm[c] = term
    /\ lockState' = [lockState EXCEPT ![d] = IF @ = "locked" THEN "unlocked" ELSE "locked"]
    /\ lastActor' = [lastActor EXCEPT ![d] = c]
    /\ authTerm' = [authTerm EXCEPT ![d] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, localTerm>>

\* A manual lever toggle bypasses the network entirely.
PhysicalOverride(d) ==
    /\ lockState' = [lockState EXCEPT ![d] = IF @ = "locked" THEN "unlocked" ELSE "locked"]
    /\ lastActor' = [lastActor EXCEPT ![d] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, localTerm, authTerm>>

Next ==
    \/ Elect
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in Doors : Actuate(c, d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : PhysicalOverride(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stale or unauthorized controller is ever recorded as the origin of
\* a door's most recent command issued during the current term.
NoStaleOrigin ==
    \A d \in Doors :
        (lastActor[d] # "none" /\ authTerm[d] = term) => lastActor[d] = leader
====
nl:
A smart-home door lock network is managed by two independent hub
controllers, A and B, that both have network access to one shared pool of
networked door locks. The hubs use leader election with failover: a term
counter increases every time a new leader is elected, and each controller
keeps a local record of the highest term it has synced to. A controller
may only send a lock or unlock command to a door if it is the currently
elected leader and its local record is synced to the current term -- a
controller that has failed over away from leadership, or has not yet
learned about a more recent election, is stale and must not be able to
command the network. Each door also has a manual physical lever that can
lock or unlock it directly with no network authorization at all, which is
allowed but is recorded as coming from no network participant so it is
never mistaken for an authorized command. Across every election and every
command, only the instance that is truly the current leader for the
current term is ever recorded as the authorized origin of a door's most
recent network-issued state change.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, for every door whose lock state
was last changed by a network command during the current term, the
controller recorded as having made that change is the current leader --
no unauthorized or stale participant is ever recorded as the origin of a
current-term command.

spec_text:
------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m2p6t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Branches, MaxEpoch

Epochs == 1..MaxEpoch

\* epoch is the coordinator's currently open round. epochOf[b] records the
\* round in which branch b's vote was last counted (0 = never counted).
\* inflight models the unreliable network: vote messages sit in a set, so
\* they may be drained in any order, i.e. reordered or delayed.

VARIABLES epoch, phase, revoked, inflight, epochOf

vars == <<epoch, phase, revoked, inflight, epochOf>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ revoked = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ epochOf = [b \in Branches |-> 0]

NewRound ==
    /\ phase = "Committed"
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE 1
    /\ phase' = "Prepare"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<revoked, inflight, epochOf>>

SendVote(b) ==
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ b \notin revoked
    /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<b, epoch>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, phase, revoked, epochOf>>

DrainVote(b, e) ==
    /\ <<b, e>> \in inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<b, e>>}
    /\ IF e = epoch /\ b \notin revoked
       THEN epochOf' = [epochOf EXCEPT ![b] = e]
       ELSE epochOf' = epochOf
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, phase, revoked>>

Revoke(b) ==
    /\ b \notin revoked
    /\ revoked' = revoked \cup {b}
    /\ epochOf' = [epochOf EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, phase, inflight>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "Prepare"
    /\ \A b \in Branches \ revoked : epochOf[b] = epoch
    /\ phase' = "Committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, revoked, inflight, epochOf>>

Next ==
    \/ NewRound
    \/ \E b \in Branches : SendVote(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches, e \in Epochs : DrainVote(b, e)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Revoke(b)
    \/ Commit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleOrRevokedCommit ==
    phase = "Committed" => \A b \in Branches \ revoked : epochOf[b] = epoch

=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Branches = {b1, b2, b3}
    MaxEpoch = 3
INVARIANT NoStaleOrRevokedCommit
nl:
A regional library consortium commits a shared-title reservation across its member
branches using two-phase commit. A coordinator opens a numbered round (an epoch) and
each branch casts a vote message for that round. Because branch links run over an
unreliable inter-library network, vote messages travel independently and can be
reordered or delayed: a vote cast in an old round can still be delivered after the
coordinator has already moved on to a newer round. The coordinator only counts a vote
toward the current commit if it was cast in the round currently open; a vote that
arrives late from an earlier round is stale and must be discarded rather than counted.
Separately, the consortium can revoke a branch's membership at any time (for example
after a contract dispute); a revoked branch's standing is cleared immediately, and any
vote of theirs that was previously counted is withdrawn. The coordinator commits the
reservation for the round only once every branch that is still a member has a counted
vote for that exact round.

Actions: the coordinator opens the next round once the previous round committed; a
member branch sends a vote message tagged with the round it believes is current; the
coordinator drains one vote message from the network and counts it only if its round
matches the currently open round and its sender is still a member, discarding it
otherwise; the consortium revokes a branch's membership and clears any vote it had
counted; the coordinator commits the round once every remaining member has a
counted vote for the current round.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a round is committed, every branch that is still a member
has a vote that was counted in that exact round, so no revoked branch and no branch's
stale vote from an earlier round ever contributes to a commit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m3p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Servers, MaxTerm

VARIABLES role, term, votes, granted

Vars == <<role, term, votes, granted>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ role \in [Servers -> {"Follower", "Candidate", "Leader"}]
  /\ term \in [Servers -> 0..MaxTerm]
  /\ votes \in [Servers -> SUBSET Servers]
  /\ granted \in [Servers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ role = [s \in Servers |-> "Follower"]
  /\ term = [s \in Servers |-> 0]
  /\ votes = [s \in Servers |-> {}]
  /\ granted = [s \in Servers |-> FALSE]

\* A slow branch server can lag arbitrarily before it notices a missing
\* leader; lagging never counts as failing, it just delays this step.
Timeout(s) ==
  /\ role[s] # "Leader"
  /\ term[s] < MaxTerm
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![s] = "Candidate"]
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![s] = term[s] + 1]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED granted

\* A voter backs a same-or-newer-term candidate at most once per term.
Vote(voter, cand) ==
  /\ voter # cand
  /\ role[cand] = "Candidate"
  /\ term[voter] <= term[cand]
  /\ voter \notin votes[cand]
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![voter] = term[cand]]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![cand] = votes[cand] \cup {voter}]
  /\ role' = IF term[cand] > term[voter] /\ role[voter] = "Leader"
             THEN [role EXCEPT ![voter] = "Follower"]
             ELSE role
  /\ UNCHANGED granted

\* A candidate backed by a strict majority of branch servers becomes leader.
BecomeLeader(s) ==
  /\ role[s] = "Candidate"
  /\ 2 * Cardinality(votes[s]) > Cardinality(Servers)
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![s] = "Leader"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votes, granted>>

\* A leader that learns of a strictly newer term elsewhere steps down.
StepDown(s) ==
  /\ role[s] = "Leader"
  /\ \E t \in Servers : term[t] > term[s]
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![s] = "Follower"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votes, granted>>

\* Only a leader at the freshest known term, with the copy currently free,
\* may grant a hold -- the fencing check that backstops the election itself.
Grant(s) ==
  /\ role[s] = "Leader"
  /\ \A t \in Servers : term[t] <= term[s]
  /\ \A o \in Servers : ~granted[o]
  /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<role, term, votes>>

Release(s) ==
  /\ granted[s]
  /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<role, term, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Servers : Timeout(s)
  \/ \E voter, cand \in Servers : Vote(voter, cand)
  \/ \E s \in Servers : BecomeLeader(s)
  \/ \E s \in Servers : StepDown(s)
  \/ \E s \in Servers : Grant(s)
  \/ \E s \in Servers : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_Vars

\* At most one branch server ever holds grant authority on the shared copy.
MutualExclusion == Cardinality({s \in Servers : granted[s]}) <= 1
====

CONSTANTS
Servers = {s1, s2, s3}
MaxTerm = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A library branch network runs a book reservation service backed by leader
election with failover. Among a fixed set of branch servers, exactly one is
elected leader at a time, and only the leader may grant a hold on a given
physical copy of a book to a patron. Branch servers periodically send
heartbeats; if the leader's heartbeat is missed the remaining servers elect a
new leader and the old leader must step down before any new hold is granted.
A branch server can be arbitrarily slow to heartbeat, campaign, or process a
grant -- slowness alone never counts as a failure and a slow server remains a
legitimate candidate and, once elected, a legitimate leader. The system must
guarantee that at any moment at most one branch server believes itself to be
the leader and holds grant authority for the shared copy, so two branches can
never both place a hold on the same physical copy at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, at most one branch server is in
the Leader role holding grant authority over the shared copy.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m2p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS R1, R2, TotalUnits, TransferAmt

Participants == {R1, R2}

VARIABLES pool, inTransit, held, phase, pending

vars == <<pool, inTransit, held, phase, pending>>

\* Two-phase commit over a reorderable network: outstanding acks are kept
\* as a set, not a sequence, so the coordinator does not care which robot
\* answers first. A rejection aborts the whole transfer and rolls the
\* reserved units back to the shared pool.

Init ==
    /\ pool = TotalUnits
    /\ inTransit = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ held = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ pending = {}

Propose ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ pool >= 2 * TransferAmt
    /\ phase' = "preparing"
    /\ pending' = Participants
    /\ pool' = pool - 2 * TransferAmt
    /\ inTransit' = [p \in Participants |-> TransferAmt]
    /\ UNCHANGED held

Ack(p) ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, inTransit, held, phase>>

Nack(p) ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ phase' = "aborting"
    /\ pending' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, inTransit, held>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ held' = [p \in Participants |-> held[p] + inTransit[p]]
    /\ inTransit' = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, pending>>

Rollback ==
    /\ phase = "aborting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ pool' = pool + inTransit[R1] + inTransit[R2]
    /\ inTransit' = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, pending>>

\* A robot may return held units to the shared pool for a future transfer.
Return(p) ==
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inTransit, phase, pending>>

AckR1 == Ack(R1)
AckR2 == Ack(R2)
NackR1 == Nack(R1)
NackR2 == Nack(R2)
ReturnR1 == Return(R1)
ReturnR2 == Return(R2)

Next ==
    \/ Propose
    \/ AckR1 \/ AckR2
    \/ NackR1 \/ NackR2
    \/ Commit \/ Rollback
    \/ ReturnR1 \/ ReturnR2

\* Every in-flight transfer is guaranteed to resolve, either into a
\* commit or an abort-and-rollback.
Fairness ==
    /\ WF_vars(AckR1) /\ WF_vars(AckR2)
    /\ WF_vars(NackR1) /\ WF_vars(NackR2)
    /\ WF_vars(Commit) /\ WF_vars(Rollback)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

\* Conservation: units only ever move between the pool, the in-transit
\* holding areas, and the robots' permanent inventories.
UnitsConserved ==
    pool + inTransit[R1] + inTransit[R2] + held[R1] + held[R2] = TotalUnits

TransferFinalizes == (phase = "preparing") ~> (phase = "idle")

CONSTANTS
  R1 = R1
  R2 = R2
  TotalUnits = 4

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT UnitsConserved
PROPERTY TransferFinalizes
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates inventory transfers out of one shared
staging pool to two participant robots, R1 and R2, using two-phase commit.
The network between the coordinator and the robots can reorder messages,
so the protocol tracks outstanding acknowledgements as an unordered set
rather than assuming any delivery order: a coordinator proposes a transfer
by reserving units out of the shared pool into each robot's in-transit
holding area and marking both robots as outstanding, then waits for each
robot's acknowledgement or rejection to arrive in whatever order the
network happens to deliver them. If every outstanding robot acknowledges,
the coordinator commits and the in-transit units become permanently held
by their robots; if any robot rejects, the whole transfer aborts and every
reserved unit is rolled back into the shared pool. A robot may also return
previously held units back to the shared pool for future transfers. Across
every proposal, acknowledgement, rejection, commit, rollback and return,
units are only ever moved between the shared pool, the in-transit holding
areas, and the robots' held inventories -- never created or destroyed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the units in the shared pool
plus the units currently in transit to both robots plus the units
permanently held by both robots equal the fleet's fixed total unit count.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever the coordinator proposes a transfer, that
transfer eventually finalizes -- the coordinator always returns to idle,
either by committing once every robot has acknowledged or by rolling back
once any robot has rejected.

---- MODULE W4Od2m7p6t0 ----
(* Warehouse robot fleet: a CAS ownership register gates task claims.     *)
(* One robot may crash silently; a live robot fences the register to a   *)
(* fresh epoch so the crashed owner's stale token can never claim again. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Tasks, InitOwner, MaxEpoch, MaxCrashes

VARIABLES epoch, owner, robotEpoch, crashed, claimed

vars == <<epoch, owner, robotEpoch, crashed, claimed>>

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 1
  /\ owner = InitOwner
  /\ robotEpoch = [r \in Robots |-> IF r = InitOwner THEN 1 ELSE 0]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ claimed = {}

Crash(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < MaxCrashes
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, robotEpoch, claimed>>

Fence(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ owner \in crashed
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ owner' = r
  /\ robotEpoch' = [robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, claimed>>

Sync(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ robotEpoch' = [robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, crashed, claimed>>

ClaimTask(r, t) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ r = owner
  /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
  /\ t \notin claimed
  /\ claimed' = claimed \cup {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, robotEpoch, crashed>>

ProgressStep ==
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Fence(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, t \in Tasks : ClaimTask(r, t)

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Crash(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Fence(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, t \in Tasks : ClaimTask(r, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(ProgressStep)

\* Safety: a live owner's token always matches the register's epoch, so a
\* claim can never come from an unauthorized or stale participant.
NoStaleClaim == (owner \notin crashed) => (robotEpoch[owner] = epoch)

\* Liveness: despite one silent crash, every task is eventually claimed.
LivenessProp == <>(claimed = Tasks)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Robots = {r0, r1, r2}
  Tasks = {t1, t2}
  InitOwner = r0
  MaxEpoch = 3
  MaxCrashes = 1

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoStaleClaim
PROPERTY LivenessProp
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates access to the picking floor through a
single compare-and-swap ownership register: whichever robot holds the
register may claim pending pick tasks, and every robot stamps its claims
with the token (epoch) it last read from the register. One robot in the
fleet can crash silently at any point -- it simply stops acting, with no
notification to the others -- and if it happened to be holding the
register when it crashed, its token becomes stale. Any other still-live
robot may then perform a fencing compare-and-swap: it bumps the register
to a new epoch and installs itself as the new owner with a matching fresh
token, so the crashed robot's old token can never again match the
register and can never be used to claim a task. A robot may claim a task
only while it is the current owner and its own recorded token equals the
register's current epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the current register owner has not silently
crashed, that owner's recorded token equals the register's current epoch
-- so no task claim ever comes from a participant who is unauthorized
(not the current owner) or stale (holding an epoch the register has since
moved past).
LIVENESS PROPERTY: even though one robot may crash silently at any time,
every pick task is eventually claimed -- the surviving fleet always
fences off a stale or crashed owner and resumes claiming.

---- MODULE W4Od3m7p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Accounts, MaxBal, MaxAmt, InitBalance, MaxAdminTotal

VARIABLES balance, injected, withdrawn, pending

Vars == <<balance, injected, withdrawn, pending>>

\* Sum of all member account balances (recursive fold over a finite set).
RECURSIVE SumBalance(_)
SumBalance(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
                 ELSE LET a == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
                      IN balance[a] + SumBalance(S \ {a})
TotalBalance == SumBalance(Accounts)
InitialTotal == Cardinality(Accounts) * InitBalance

TypeOK ==
  /\ balance \in [Accounts -> 0..MaxBal]
  /\ injected \in 0..MaxAdminTotal
  /\ withdrawn \in 0..MaxAdminTotal
  /\ pending = "none" \/ pending \in (Accounts \times Accounts \times (1..MaxAmt) \times (0..MaxBal) \times (0..MaxBal))

Init ==
  /\ balance = [a \in Accounts |-> InitBalance]
  /\ injected = 0
  /\ withdrawn = 0
  /\ pending = "none"

\* A worker reads both account balances it intends to move funds between.
BeginTransfer(src, dst, amt) ==
  /\ pending = "none"
  /\ src # dst
  /\ balance[src] >= amt
  /\ pending' = <<src, dst, amt, balance[src], balance[dst]>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, injected, withdrawn>>

\* Both compare-and-swaps only succeed if neither account moved since the
\* read -- otherwise a stale worker cannot corrupt the ledger.
CommitTransfer ==
  /\ pending # "none"
  /\ balance[pending[1]] = pending[4]
  /\ balance[pending[2]] = pending[5]
  /\ balance[pending[2]] + pending[3] <= MaxBal
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![pending[1]] = @ - pending[3],
                                 ![pending[2]] = @ + pending[3]]
  /\ pending' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<injected, withdrawn>>

\* A stale compare-and-swap -- or one that would now overflow the
\* destination -- is rejected; the worker abandons this attempt.
AbortTransfer ==
  /\ pending # "none"
  /\ ~(balance[pending[1]] = pending[4]
       /\ balance[pending[2]] = pending[5]
       /\ balance[pending[2]] + pending[3] <= MaxBal)
  /\ pending' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, injected, withdrawn>>

\* The admin override bypasses the paired debit/credit CAS entirely.
AdminInject(a, amt) ==
  /\ balance[a] + amt <= MaxBal
  /\ injected + amt <= MaxAdminTotal
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![a] = @ + amt]
  /\ injected' = injected + amt
  /\ UNCHANGED <<withdrawn, pending>>

AdminWithdraw(a, amt) ==
  /\ balance[a] >= amt
  /\ withdrawn + amt <= MaxAdminTotal
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![a] = @ - amt]
  /\ withdrawn' = withdrawn + amt
  /\ UNCHANGED <<injected, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E src, dst \in Accounts, amt \in 1..MaxAmt : BeginTransfer(src, dst, amt)
  \/ CommitTransfer
  \/ AbortTransfer
  \/ \E a \in Accounts, amt \in 1..MaxAmt : AdminInject(a, amt)
  \/ \E a \in Accounts, amt \in 1..MaxAmt : AdminWithdraw(a, amt)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_Vars

\* Ordinary transfers preserve the total; only the admin override may move
\* it, and only by exactly what it injected or withdrew.
Conservation == TotalBalance = InitialTotal + injected - withdrawn
====

CONSTANTS
Accounts = {a1, a2}
MaxBal = 4
MaxAmt = 1
InitBalance = 2
MaxAdminTotal = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A clearing house runs an interbank settlement batch across a fixed set of
member bank accounts. Each account's balance is stored in a compare-and-swap
register: to move funds, a settlement worker reads the source and
destination account balances, then performs two compare-and-swaps -- one
debiting the source and one crediting the destination -- each of which only
succeeds if that account's register still holds the value the worker last
read, so a stale worker's transfer is rejected rather than silently
corrupting the ledger. A privileged admin override exists that lets an
operator inject or withdraw funds directly into a single account's register
outside the normal two-account transfer path, bypassing the paired
debit/credit compare-and-swap, for regulatory adjustments. Every ordinary
transfer between two member accounts must leave the sum of all balances
across the batch unchanged; only the admin override may change that total,
and it must change the total by exactly the amount it injects or withdraws.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the sum of all member account
balances equals the initial total sum plus the net amount injected by the
admin override so far, minus the net amount withdrawn by the admin override
so far.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m2p5t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxBays

Cars == {"car1", "car2"}
Stations == {"washCtl", "dryCtl"}

\* phase[c] tracks each car's two-phase commit state; votes[c] collects the
\* stations that have voted ready; releaseCount[c] counts how many times the
\* irreversible release has actually fired for c (must stay at most one).

VARIABLES bays, phase, votes, releaseCount

vars == <<bays, phase, votes, releaseCount>>

OnLine == {c \in Cars : phase[c] = "Prepare"}

Init ==
    /\ bays = 1
    /\ phase = [c \in Cars |-> "Idle"]
    /\ votes = [c \in Cars |-> {}]
    /\ releaseCount = [c \in Cars |-> 0]

Enter(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "Idle"
    /\ Cardinality(OnLine) < bays
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "Prepare"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bays, votes, releaseCount>>

Vote(c, s) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "Prepare"
    /\ s \notin votes[c]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bays, phase, releaseCount>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "Prepare"
    /\ votes[c] = Stations
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "Released"]
    /\ releaseCount' = [releaseCount EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bays, votes>>

GrowBays ==
    /\ bays < MaxBays
    /\ bays' = bays + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, releaseCount>>

ShrinkBays ==
    /\ bays > 0
    /\ Cardinality(OnLine) <= bays - 1
    /\ bays' = bays - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, releaseCount>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, s \in Stations : Vote(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Release(c)
    \/ GrowBays
    \/ ShrinkBays

Spec ==
    /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
    /\ WF_vars(Vote("car1", "washCtl") \/ Vote("car1", "dryCtl") \/ Release("car1"))
    /\ WF_vars(Vote("car2", "washCtl") \/ Vote("car2", "dryCtl") \/ Release("car2"))

ReleaseAtMostOnce == \A c \in Cars : releaseCount[c] <= 1

EveryPreparedCarReleased == \A c \in Cars : (phase[c] = "Prepare") ~> (phase[c] = "Released")

=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxBays = 2
INVARIANT ReleaseAtMostOnce
PROPERTY EveryPreparedCarReleased
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves cars through wash and dry stations toward a final,
irreversible release onto the exit ramp. A car may only enter the line while the
conveyor has open capacity; the operator can change that capacity at runtime, adding
bays during a slow period or removing them during maintenance, though a bay can only
be removed while it would not push the cars currently on the line over the new
capacity. Once on the line, a car must be committed via two-phase commit between the
wash station and the dry station: each station casts its own ready vote for that car,
and only once both stations have voted ready does the release fire, which is
permanent and can never be undone or repeated for that car.

Actions: a car enters the line while the line's occupancy is under the current
capacity; a station (wash or dry) casts a ready vote for a car that is on the line;
the release fires for a car once both stations have voted ready for it, permanently
retiring that car from the line; the operator grows capacity by one bay; the operator
shrinks capacity by one bay, but only when the cars currently on the line would still
fit under the smaller capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible release never fires more than once for the same
car.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: every car that is on the line waiting for its two-phase commit
eventually gets released, so no car is left stalled on the conveyor forever.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m6p4t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, BaseCapacity, MaxBoost, MaxTTL

\* leaseTTL[p] > 0 means p holds a live lease with that many ticks left.
\* boost is the admin's temporary addition to BaseCapacity; the two
\* together give the effective ceiling that Grant and the admin's own
\* actions must respect.

VARIABLES leaseTTL, reserved, boost, kicked

vars == <<leaseTTL, reserved, boost, kicked>>

Live == {p \in Players : leaseTTL[p] > 0}
EffectiveCapacity == BaseCapacity + boost

Init ==
    /\ leaseTTL = [p \in Players |-> 0]
    /\ reserved = {}
    /\ boost = 0
    /\ kicked = {}

Request(p) ==
    /\ p \notin reserved
    /\ p \notin kicked
    /\ leaseTTL[p] = 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTTL, boost, kicked>>

Grant(p) ==
    /\ p \in reserved
    /\ Cardinality(Live) < EffectiveCapacity
    /\ leaseTTL' = [leaseTTL EXCEPT ![p] = MaxTTL]
    /\ reserved' = reserved \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<boost, kicked>>

Tick ==
    /\ leaseTTL' = [p \in Players |-> IF leaseTTL[p] > 0 THEN leaseTTL[p] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, boost, kicked>>

AdminBoost ==
    /\ boost < MaxBoost
    /\ boost' = boost + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTTL, reserved, kicked>>

AdminRevokeBoost ==
    /\ boost > 0
    /\ Cardinality(Live) <= BaseCapacity + boost - 1
    /\ boost' = boost - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTTL, reserved, kicked>>

AdminKick(p) ==
    /\ leaseTTL[p] > 0 \/ p \in reserved
    /\ leaseTTL' = [leaseTTL EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ reserved' = reserved \ {p}
    /\ kicked' = kicked \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED boost

Readmit(p) ==
    /\ p \in kicked
    /\ kicked' = kicked \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTTL, reserved, boost>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Request(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Grant(p)
    \/ Tick
    \/ AdminBoost
    \/ AdminRevokeBoost
    \/ \E p \in Players : AdminKick(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Readmit(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == Cardinality(Live) <= EffectiveCapacity

=============================================================================

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2, p3}
    BaseCapacity = 1
    MaxBoost = 1
    MaxTTL = 2
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker admits players under a bounded capacity using
short-lived leases. A player who is admitted receives a lease with a countdown; the
lease decays over time and the player's spot is automatically freed once it reaches
zero, so a crashed or disconnected player can never hold a spot forever. A player must
first queue a request, and the matchmaker only grants a lease when the number of
players currently holding a live lease is below the capacity that is in effect right
now. A supervising admin has a privileged override: they may temporarily raise the
effective capacity ceiling for a busy event, or lower it back down again, but a
reduction is only allowed when it would not put the lobby over the (now smaller)
ceiling. The admin may also kick a player outright, immediately clearing their lease
or queued request and marking them kicked until they are formally readmitted.

Actions: a player queues a request for a spot; the matchmaker grants a lease to a
queued player provided live leases are still under the current effective capacity; a
tick decays every live lease's countdown by one, freeing any lease that reaches zero;
the admin raises the effective capacity ceiling by one; the admin lowers the ceiling
by one, but only when current usage still fits under the smaller ceiling; the admin
kicks a player, clearing any lease or queued request they hold; a kicked player is
readmitted so they may queue again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of players holding a live lease never exceeds the
effective capacity ceiling currently in force, including immediately after any admin
override raises or lowers that ceiling.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m7p3t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxSlots

Slots == 1..MaxSlots
Players == {"pA", "pB"}

\* owner[s] is the (at most one) claimant of slot s. witnessed holds
\* <<player, slot>> pairs for the read half of a compare-and-swap; Resolve
\* performs the actual compare-and-set against what was witnessed, so a
\* stale read simply fails instead of double-claiming.

VARIABLES capacity, owner, witnessed, waiting

vars == <<capacity, owner, witnessed, waiting>>

Init ==
    /\ capacity = 1
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ witnessed = {}
    /\ waiting = {}

WitnessEmpty(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin waiting
    /\ s <= capacity
    /\ owner[s] = {}
    /\ \A t \in Slots : <<p, t>> \notin witnessed /\ p \notin owner[t]
    /\ witnessed' = witnessed \cup {<<p, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, owner, waiting>>

Resolve(p, s) ==
    /\ <<p, s>> \in witnessed
    /\ witnessed' = witnessed \ {<<p, s>>}
    /\ IF owner[s] = {}
       THEN owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {p}]
       ELSE owner' = owner
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, waiting>>

Release(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in owner[s]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, witnessed, waiting>>

GrowCapacity ==
    /\ capacity < MaxSlots
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, witnessed, waiting>>

ShrinkCapacity ==
    /\ capacity > 0
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup owner[capacity]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![capacity] = {}]
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED witnessed

Retry(p) ==
    /\ p \in waiting
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capacity, owner, witnessed>>

ResolveAny(p) == \E s \in Slots : Resolve(p, s)

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : WitnessEmpty(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Resolve(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Release(p, s)
    \/ GrowCapacity
    \/ ShrinkCapacity
    \/ \E p \in Players : Retry(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(ResolveAny("pA")) /\ WF_vars(ResolveAny("pB"))

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : Cardinality(owner[s]) <= 1
    /\ \A p \in Players : Cardinality({s \in Slots : p \in owner[s]}) <= 1

PendingResolves ==
    \A p \in Players :
        (\E s \in Slots : <<p, s>> \in witnessed) ~> ~(\E s \in Slots : <<p, s>> \in witnessed)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxSlots = 2
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
PROPERTY PendingResolves
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby fills its open slots with a compare-and-swap register per
slot. A player who wants a slot first reads the slot's register (a witness of what it
currently holds) and then performs the actual compare-and-swap: the swap only takes
effect if the register still matches what the player witnessed, otherwise the attempt
silently loses the race and the player is free to try again. The lobby's capacity
changes at runtime: an operator can open an additional slot at any time, and can also
shrink capacity, which evicts whichever player currently sits in the top slot back
into a waiting pool so they can attempt to rejoin once capacity allows. A player only
ever has one outstanding compare-and-swap attempt at a time, and a player who already
holds a slot cannot start a new attempt until they release it.

Actions: a player who currently holds no slot and has no outstanding attempt
witnesses an open slot's register as currently empty and records an attempt; a
player's outstanding attempt resolves -- the compare-and-swap succeeds and
claims the slot if it is still empty, otherwise it fails and the attempt is simply
dropped; a player already holding a slot releases it; the operator grows capacity by
one slot; the operator shrinks capacity by one, evicting the top slot's occupant into
the waiting pool; an evicted player leaves the waiting pool so they can try again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever claimed by more than one player at once, and no
player ever ends up holding two slots at once, so the compare-and-swap never
double-allocates a slot.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: whenever a player has an outstanding compare-and-swap attempt on a
slot, that attempt is eventually resolved, one way or the other, so no player is left
waiting on a claim forever.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m2p0t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS InitialPriority

Instances == {"instA", "instB"}
Participants == {"arbiter", "safety"}

Other(i) == IF i = "instA" THEN "instB" ELSE "instA"

\* holds[i] is whether controller i currently occupies the shared shaft.
\* votes[i] collects the two-phase-commit votes for i's pending request.
\* priorityToken breaks ties when both controllers are fully voted at once.

VARIABLES holds, votes, reqPhase, priorityToken

vars == <<holds, votes, reqPhase, priorityToken>>

Init ==
    /\ holds = [i \in Instances |-> FALSE]
    /\ votes = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ reqPhase = [i \in Instances |-> "Idle"]
    /\ priorityToken = InitialPriority

BeginPrepare(i) ==
    /\ reqPhase[i] = "Idle"
    /\ ~holds[i]
    /\ reqPhase' = [reqPhase EXCEPT ![i] = "Prepare"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, votes, priorityToken>>

Vote(i, p) ==
    /\ reqPhase[i] = "Prepare"
    /\ p \notin votes[i]
    /\ ~holds[Other(i)]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, reqPhase, priorityToken>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ reqPhase[i] = "Prepare"
    /\ votes[i] = Participants
    /\ priorityToken = i
    /\ ~holds[Other(i)]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ reqPhase' = [reqPhase EXCEPT ![i] = "Idle"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED priorityToken

Abort(i) ==
    /\ reqPhase[i] = "Prepare"
    /\ holds[Other(i)]
    /\ reqPhase' = [reqPhase EXCEPT ![i] = "Idle"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, priorityToken>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ holds[i]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ priorityToken' = Other(i)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, reqPhase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : BeginPrepare(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, p \in Participants : Vote(i, p)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Abort(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion == ~(holds["instA"] /\ holds["instB"])

=============================================================================
