SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    InitialPriority = "instA"
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A skyscraper runs two independent elevator bank controllers, instA and instB, that
each dispatch their own group of cars but share a single express shaft as one common
pool: only one controller's car may occupy that shaft at a time. Access to the shaft
is granted by two-phase commit between two participants, an arbiter and a safety
interlock, both of which must vote ready for a controller's request before it may
enter the shaft. A participant refuses to vote ready for a controller while the other
controller currently occupies the shaft. If both controllers are prepared and fully
voted at once, only the controller currently holding the priority token may actually
commit and enter; a controller with a pending request that discovers the other
controller has taken the shaft first simply aborts and can try again later. When a
controller leaves the shaft it releases it and hands the priority token to the other
controller.

Actions: a controller begins preparing a request for the shaft; a participant (the
arbiter or the safety interlock) casts a ready vote for a controller's pending
request, refusing to do so while the other controller holds the shaft; a controller
whose request is fully voted commits and enters the shaft, but only if it currently
holds the priority token and the other controller does not hold the shaft; a
controller abandons its pending request once it finds the other controller already
holding the shaft; a controller that holds the shaft releases it and passes the
priority token to the other controller.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the two controllers never occupy the shared express shaft at the
same time.

---- MODULE W4Od6m8p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Capacity

VARIABLES pool, reserved, coarseLock, fineLock

vars == <<pool, reserved, coarseLock, fineLock>>

\* Hierarchical locking: a car takes the coarse bank-wide lock before the
\* fine per-car ledger lock, then moves tokens between the shared pool and
\* its own reservation. The admin console may seize the coarse lock out of
\* the normal acquire order to recover a stuck car's reserved tokens.

Init ==
    /\ pool = Capacity
    /\ reserved = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ coarseLock = "none"
    /\ fineLock = "none"

AcquireCoarse(c) ==
    /\ coarseLock = "none"
    /\ coarseLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, reserved, fineLock>>

AcquireFine(c) ==
    /\ coarseLock = c
    /\ fineLock = "none"
    /\ fineLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, reserved, coarseLock>>

Reserve(c) ==
    /\ fineLock = c
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ fineLock = c
    /\ reserved[c] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ fineLock' = "none"
    /\ coarseLock' = "none"

AdminOverride(c) ==
    /\ coarseLock = c
    /\ pool' = pool + reserved[c]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
    /\ fineLock' = "none"
    /\ coarseLock' = "none"

AcquireCoarseC1 == AcquireCoarse("C1")
AcquireCoarseC2 == AcquireCoarse("C2")
AcquireFineC1 == AcquireFine("C1")
AcquireFineC2 == AcquireFine("C2")
ReserveC1 == Reserve("C1")
ReserveC2 == Reserve("C2")
ReleaseC1 == Release("C1")
ReleaseC2 == Release("C2")
AdminOverrideC1 == AdminOverride("C1")
AdminOverrideC2 == AdminOverride("C2")

Next ==
    \/ AcquireCoarseC1 \/ AcquireCoarseC2
    \/ AcquireFineC1 \/ AcquireFineC2
    \/ ReserveC1 \/ ReserveC2
    \/ ReleaseC1 \/ ReleaseC2
    \/ AdminOverrideC1 \/ AdminOverrideC2

\* Progress comes either from a car finishing its own transaction, or the
\* admin console reclaiming a stuck car's lock; both are given fairness.
Fairness ==
    /\ WF_vars(ReleaseC1) /\ WF_vars(ReleaseC2)
    /\ WF_vars(AdminOverrideC1) /\ WF_vars(AdminOverrideC2)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

\* Conservation: every dispatch token is either in the shared pool or
\* reserved by exactly one car; none are ever created or destroyed.
TokensConserved == pool + reserved["C1"] + reserved["C2"] = Capacity

LockEventuallyReleased == (coarseLock # "none") ~> (coarseLock = "none")
====

CONSTANTS
  Cars = {"C1", "C2"}
  Capacity = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT TokensConserved
PROPERTY LockEventuallyReleased
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper manages a fixed pool of dispatch-capacity
tokens shared by every car. A car may only move a token between the shared
pool and its own private reservation ledger after acquiring a coarse,
bank-wide lock and then a fine-grained lock on its own ledger, in that order.
Normally a car that holds the coarse lock must finish its reservation
transaction and release both locks before another car can proceed, but the
building also has a privileged admin console that can seize the coarse lock
away from whichever car holds it -- bypassing the normal acquire order -- to
force a stuck car's reserved tokens back into the shared pool and reset the
locks to idle. Across every transition, the tokens sitting in the shared
pool plus the tokens reserved by every car must sum to the bank's total
capacity: dispatch tokens are only ever moved between the pool and a car's
ledger, never created or destroyed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the sum of the tokens in the
shared pool and the tokens reserved across all cars equals the bank's fixed
total capacity.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever a car acquires the coarse bank lock, the lock
is eventually released back to idle, either because the car completes its
reservation transaction or because the admin console seizes and clears it.

---- MODULE W4Od7m1p1t1 ----
(* Crane-yard token ring: only the current token round may originate an   *)
(* update, but delivery to the shared record can reorder those messages.  *)
(* A round-stamped, strictly-increasing apply guard means a stale,        *)
(* reordered proposal is dropped rather than clobbering a newer one.      *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumCranes, MaxRound, Values, InitValue

VARIABLES tokenPos, round, sentRounds, inflight, recordVal, recordVersion

vars == <<tokenPos, round, sentRounds, inflight, recordVal, recordVersion>>

Init ==
  /\ tokenPos = 1
  /\ round = 0
  /\ sentRounds = {}
  /\ inflight = {}
  /\ recordVal = InitValue
  /\ recordVersion = 0

AdvanceToken ==
  /\ round < MaxRound
  /\ tokenPos' = (tokenPos % NumCranes) + 1
  /\ round' = round + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sentRounds, inflight, recordVal, recordVersion>>

SendUpdate(v) ==
  /\ round > 0
  /\ round \notin sentRounds
  /\ sentRounds' = sentRounds \cup {round}
  /\ inflight' = inflight \cup {<<round, v>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, round, recordVal, recordVersion>>

ApplyUpdate(r, v) ==
  /\ <<r, v>> \in inflight
  /\ r > recordVersion
  /\ recordVal' = v
  /\ recordVersion' = r
  /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<r, v>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, round, sentRounds>>

DropStale(r, v) ==
  /\ <<r, v>> \in inflight
  /\ r <= recordVersion
  /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<r, v>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, round, sentRounds, recordVal, recordVersion>>

\* The ring has made its last hand-off, the final round is already sent,
\* and nothing is left in transit: idle here instead of a false deadlock.
Done == /\ round = MaxRound
        /\ round \in sentRounds
        /\ inflight = {}

Terminating == Done /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ AdvanceToken
  \/ \E v \in Values : SendUpdate(v)
  \/ \E r \in 1..MaxRound, v \in Values : ApplyUpdate(r, v)
  \/ \E r \in 1..MaxRound, v \in Values : DropStale(r, v)
  \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Safety: every sent round is either folded into (or superseded by) the
\* record's current version, or still pending -- no update ever vanishes.
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A r \in sentRounds : r <= recordVersion \/ (\E v \in Values : <<r, v>> \in inflight)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  NumCranes = 3
  MaxRound = 3
  Values = {lo, hi}
  InitValue = lo

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
In a container-ship crane yard, a token circulates in a fixed ring among
the yard cranes, and only the crane currently holding the token may
propose an update to the shared yard-assignment record for that round.
Proposed updates travel to the record store as separate messages, and the
network between the cranes and the store can reorder those messages, so a
proposal sent during an earlier round may arrive and be considered after a
proposal from a later round has already been applied. The record store
tags every proposal with the round it was sent in and only applies a
proposal if its round is strictly newer than the round already reflected
in the record; a proposal that arrives after a newer one has already
landed is recognized as stale and is discarded instead of being applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every update ever sent by a crane is, at all times,
either already reflected in (or superseded by a strictly newer round
already applied to) the shared record, or still waiting to be resolved as
a pending message -- no sent update ever silently disappears, so no
update to the shared yard-assignment record is ever lost, regardless of
how the delivery messages are reordered.

---- MODULE W4Od8m4p3t1 ----
(* University course registration: a bounded work queue with backpressure  *)
(* feeds allocation-offer messages that a reordering network may resolve   *)
(* out of order.  A stale offer for an already-finalized seat or student   *)
(* is discarded, so the commit log stays a well-formed seat-to-student map.*)
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Students, Seats, MaxQueue

VARIABLES queue, requested, inflight, committed, rejected

vars == <<queue, requested, inflight, committed, rejected>>

SeatTaken(seat) == \E s \in Students : <<seat, s>> \in committed
HasSeat(s) == \E seat \in Seats : <<seat, s>> \in committed

Init ==
  /\ queue = <<>>
  /\ requested = {}
  /\ inflight = {}
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ rejected = {}

Submit(s) ==
  /\ s \notin requested
  /\ Len(queue) < MaxQueue
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, s)
  /\ requested' = requested \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, committed, rejected>>

RejectFull(s) ==
  /\ s \notin requested
  /\ Len(queue) = MaxQueue
  /\ rejected' = rejected \cup {s}
  /\ requested' = requested \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inflight, committed>>

Dequeue ==
  /\ queue # <<>>
  /\ \E seat \in Seats : inflight' = inflight \cup {<<Head(queue), seat>>}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<requested, committed, rejected>>

Commit(s, seat) ==
  /\ <<s, seat>> \in inflight
  /\ ~SeatTaken(seat)
  /\ ~HasSeat(s)
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {<<seat, s>>}
  /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<s, seat>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, requested, rejected>>

DropOffer(s, seat) ==
  /\ <<s, seat>> \in inflight
  /\ (SeatTaken(seat) \/ HasSeat(s))
  /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<s, seat>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, requested, committed, rejected>>

\* Every student has been submitted or turned away, and the pipeline has
\* drained; the model idles here instead of reporting a spurious deadlock.
Done == /\ requested = Students
        /\ queue = <<>>
        /\ inflight = {}

Terminating == Done /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Students : Submit(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : RejectFull(s)
  \/ Dequeue
  \/ \E s \in Students, seat \in Seats : Commit(s, seat)
  \/ \E s \in Students, seat \in Seats : DropOffer(s, seat)
  \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Safety: the commit log, read as a relation, is functional on seats -- a
\* seat never appears in two records naming different students.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A x, y \in committed : x[1] = y[1] => x[2] = y[2]

====
nl:
A university course-registration system processes seat requests for a single
capped section through a bounded work queue: students submit registration
requests, but the queue only holds a fixed number of pending requests at a
time, and once it is full, new arrivals are turned away by backpressure
instead of being queued. Accepted requests are dequeued and routed toward a
candidate seat as an allocation-offer message. Because the network between
the queue processor and the seat ledger can reorder messages, offers may be
delivered and resolved in an order different from the order they were sent,
and a stale or duplicate offer that arrives for a seat or a student that has
already been finalized is discarded rather than acted on. A seat is
finalized for a student only if that seat has not already been committed to
someone else and that student does not already hold a finalized seat.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every pair of finalized allocation records in the
commit log, if the two records name the same seat, they also name the same
student -- no seat slot is ever finalized (double allocated) to two
different students, regardless of the order in which offer messages were
reordered and resolved.

---- MODULE W4Od8m6p3t0 ----
(* University course-registration lease. A claim on a seat counts down from
   LeaseLen and may be renewed exactly once before it must lapse; a lapsed or
   released seat is open to the next claim, which always replaces any lapsed
   record rather than coexisting with it. One competing student's client may
   crash silently, but its lease still counts down and lapses normally. A
   designated waiting student must never be starved out of a seat. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Students, Slots, WaitingStudent, LeaseLen
ASSUME /\ LeaseLen \in Nat /\ LeaseLen >= 1
       /\ WaitingStudent \in Students
       /\ Slots # {}

VARIABLES allocated, ticksLeft, renewedOnce, crashed

vars == <<allocated, ticksLeft, renewedOnce, crashed>>

TypeOK == /\ allocated \subseteq (Students \X Slots)
          /\ ticksLeft \in [Slots -> 0..LeaseLen]
          /\ renewedOnce \subseteq Slots
          /\ crashed \subseteq (Students \ {WaitingStudent})

Init == /\ allocated = {}
        /\ ticksLeft = [sl \in Slots |-> 0]
        /\ renewedOnce = {}
        /\ crashed = {}

Free(sl) == ~(\E s \in Students : <<s, sl>> \in allocated) \/ ticksLeft[sl] = 0

\* The waiting student claims any free-or-lapsed seat.
AcquireWaiting == \E sl \in Slots :
                     /\ Free(sl)
                     /\ allocated' = (allocated \ {p \in allocated : p[2] = sl}) \cup {<<WaitingStudent, sl>>}
                     /\ ticksLeft' = [ticksLeft EXCEPT ![sl] = LeaseLen]
                     /\ renewedOnce' = renewedOnce \ {sl}
                     /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* Any other student claims any free-or-lapsed seat.
AcquireOther == \E s \in Students \ {WaitingStudent}, sl \in Slots :
                     /\ s \notin crashed
                     /\ Free(sl)
                     /\ allocated' = (allocated \ {p \in allocated : p[2] = sl}) \cup {<<s, sl>>}
                     /\ ticksLeft' = [ticksLeft EXCEPT ![sl] = LeaseLen]
                     /\ renewedOnce' = renewedOnce \ {sl}
                     /\ UNCHANGED crashed

RenewLease == \E s \in Students, sl \in Slots :
                     /\ <<s, sl>> \in allocated
                     /\ s \notin crashed
                     /\ sl \notin renewedOnce
                     /\ ticksLeft[sl] > 0
                     /\ ticksLeft' = [ticksLeft EXCEPT ![sl] = LeaseLen]
                     /\ renewedOnce' = renewedOnce \cup {sl}
                     /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, crashed>>

ReleaseLease == \E s \in Students, sl \in Slots :
                     /\ <<s, sl>> \in allocated
                     /\ allocated' = allocated \ {<<s, sl>>}
                     /\ ticksLeft' = [ticksLeft EXCEPT ![sl] = 0]
                     /\ renewedOnce' = renewedOnce \ {sl}
                     /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* The countdown ticks down every active lease together.
Tick == /\ \E sl \in Slots : ticksLeft[sl] > 0
        /\ ticksLeft' = [sl \in Slots |-> IF ticksLeft[sl] > 0 THEN ticksLeft[sl] - 1 ELSE 0]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, renewedOnce, crashed>>

\* One of the other students' clients can crash silently.
Crash == /\ crashed = {}
         /\ \E s \in Students \ {WaitingStudent} : crashed' = {s}
         /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, ticksLeft, renewedOnce>>

Next == AcquireWaiting \/ AcquireOther \/ RenewLease \/ ReleaseLease \/ Tick \/ Crash

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Tick) /\ SF_vars(AcquireWaiting)

\* Literal property: no seat is ever simultaneously claimed by two students.
NoDoubleAllocation == \A sl \in Slots : Cardinality({s \in Students : <<s, sl>> \in allocated}) <= 1

\* Liveness: the waiting student is never starved out of a seat.
WaitingGetsSlot == <>(\E sl \in Slots : <<WaitingStudent, sl>> \in allocated)
====

CONSTANTS
    Students = {ws, o1}
    Slots = {c1}
    WaitingStudent = ws
    LeaseLen = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
PROPERTY WaitingGetsSlot
nl:
A university course-registration system grants a contested seat through a
lease: a student who claims the seat holds it only for a bounded countdown of
registration ticks, may renew that lease exactly once before it lapses, and
loses the claim automatically once the countdown reaches zero without a
renewal. Any one of the other competing students' registration clients can
crash silently, going dark without releasing its lease early, but a dark
client's lease still counts down and lapses on schedule like any other. Once a
seat's lease has lapsed or been released it is open for the next student to
claim, and a claim always replaces any lapsed lease outright rather than
letting two students ever hold the same seat. SAFETY PROPERTY: no course seat
is ever held by two different students at the same time. LIVENESS PROPERTY: one
designated waiting student is never starved out by the other, faster-cycling
students -- it always eventually claims a seat.

---- MODULE W4Od9m8p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Feeders, HardCap

VARIABLES load, ceiling, coarseHeld, fineHeld

Vars == <<load, ceiling, coarseHeld, fineHeld>>

NoFeeder == "none"

\* Sum committed load across all feeders (recursive fold over a finite set).
RECURSIVE SumLoad(_)
SumLoad(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET f == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
                   IN load[f] + SumLoad(S \ {f})
TotalLoad == SumLoad(Feeders)

TypeOK ==
  /\ load \in [Feeders -> 0..HardCap]
  /\ ceiling \in 0..HardCap
  /\ coarseHeld \in BOOLEAN
  /\ fineHeld \in Feeders \cup {NoFeeder}

Init ==
  /\ load = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
  /\ ceiling = HardCap
  /\ coarseHeld = FALSE
  /\ fineHeld = NoFeeder

\* Coarse region lock must be taken before any fine per-feeder lock, and only
\* when some feeder actually has something to shed or room to restore into.
AcquireCoarse ==
  /\ ~coarseHeld
  /\ fineHeld = NoFeeder
  /\ \E f \in Feeders : load[f] > 0 \/ TotalLoad + 1 <= ceiling
  /\ coarseHeld' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ceiling, fineHeld>>

\* Only take the fine lock on a feeder that can actually be acted on next
\* (something to shed, or headroom under the ceiling to restore into) --
\* otherwise a badly-chosen feeder could wedge the lock chain forever.
AcquireFine(f) ==
  /\ coarseHeld
  /\ fineHeld = NoFeeder
  /\ load[f] > 0 \/ TotalLoad + 1 <= ceiling
  /\ fineHeld' = f
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ceiling, coarseHeld>>

\* Committing a shed and releasing both locks happen in one atomic step.
ShedRelease(f) ==
  /\ fineHeld = f
  /\ load[f] > 0
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![f] = load[f] - 1]
  /\ coarseHeld' = FALSE
  /\ fineHeld' = NoFeeder
  /\ UNCHANGED ceiling

\* Restoring load is bounded by the CURRENT ceiling, not the hard limit --
\* so a fresh ceiling drop can never be worsened by a concurrent restore.
RestoreRelease(f) ==
  /\ fineHeld = f
  /\ TotalLoad + 1 <= ceiling
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![f] = load[f] + 1]
  /\ coarseHeld' = FALSE
  /\ fineHeld' = NoFeeder
  /\ UNCHANGED ceiling

\* The operator can only move the ceiling between lock-chains, not mid-commit,
\* so an in-flight fine-lock decision is never invalidated out from under it.
RaiseCeiling ==
  /\ ~coarseHeld
  /\ ceiling < HardCap
  /\ ceiling' = ceiling + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, coarseHeld, fineHeld>>

LowerCeiling ==
  /\ ~coarseHeld
  /\ ceiling > 0
  /\ ceiling' = ceiling - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, coarseHeld, fineHeld>>

AnyAcquireFine == \E f \in Feeders : AcquireFine(f)
AnyShedRelease == \E f \in Feeders : ShedRelease(f)

Next ==
  \/ AcquireCoarse
  \/ AnyAcquireFine
  \/ AnyShedRelease
  \/ \E f \in Feeders : RestoreRelease(f)
  \/ RaiseCeiling
  \/ LowerCeiling

\* Fairness on the lock-and-shed chain drives the shedder to make progress
\* whenever it stays enabled, without forcing quantified per-feeder clauses.
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_Vars
             /\ WF_Vars(AcquireCoarse)
             /\ WF_Vars(AnyAcquireFine)
             /\ WF_Vars(AnyShedRelease)

\* The grid's fixed physical capacity limit is never exceeded.
CapacityBound == TotalLoad <= HardCap

\* Whenever load exceeds the operator's current ceiling, it is eventually shed back.
CeilingRecovers == (TotalLoad > ceiling) ~> (TotalLoad <= ceiling)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
Feeders = {f1, f2}
HardCap = 3

SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CapacityBound
PROPERTY CeilingRecovers
nl:
A regional power grid runs an automated load shedder over a set of feeder
circuits. To shed or restore load on a feeder, a controller first acquires a
coarse region lock covering the whole zone, then a fine per-feeder lock on
the feeder itself; only after holding both may it change that feeder's
committed load, and it releases both locks together the moment the change is
committed. Restoring load onto a feeder is only permitted up to the grid
operator's current emergency capacity ceiling, and the operator may raise or
lower that ceiling at runtime as conditions change -- a sudden drop can leave
total committed load momentarily above the new ceiling. Regardless of how the
ceiling moves, total committed load must never exceed the grid's fixed
physical capacity limit. Whenever a ceiling drop (or any other change) leaves
total committed load above the current ceiling, the shedder must keep working
the coarse-then-fine lock sequence until enough feeders have been shed back
down.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the sum of committed load across
all feeders does not exceed the grid's fixed physical capacity limit.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever total committed load exceeds the current
emergency capacity ceiling, the shedder eventually sheds load back down to at
most that ceiling.
